acorus-gramineus.name: Acorus
notes: "semi-hijau abadi" for "semi-evergreen" is awkward; use "setengah hijau sepanjang tahun" or "semi-evergreen".
"Cukup tanam cukup dalam di substrat" repeats "cukup"; rephrase, e.g. "Cukup tanam dengan kedalaman memadai di substrat".
"Inggris" for "United Kingdom" is imprecise; use "Britania Raya" or "Inggris Raya".
"Cahaya kurang" for "Insufficient light" is slightly terse; "Cahaya tidak cukup" is more natural.

aegagropila-linnaei.name: Marimo
notes: #2: "yang bentuknya yang khas" has a duplicated "yang"; use "yang bentuk khasnya terbentuk karena..."
#7: "membukanya menjadi karpet" is a weak rendering of "unrolled them into thick carpets"; use "membentangkannya menjadi karpet tebal"
#7: "Para aquascaper ada yang membukanya" is awkward; use "Ada aquascaper yang membentangkannya..."
#4: "kibas-kibaskan perlahan" for "gently swish" is a bit odd for a ball in water; "goyang-goyangkan perlahan" or "bilas perlahan" is more natural
#1: the added gloss "(tersebar luas di seluruh dunia)" is not in the source; consider removing it or keeping just "Kosmopolitan"

alternanthera-bettzickiana.name: Alternanthera bettzickiana
notes: Section 4 emersed: "growth is then moderate to high" became "sedang hingga cepat" – acceptable, but "Growth rate: low" in the list is fine. The real error is in section 3: "mesh areas" was translated as "daerah berawa" (swampy areas); the source is likely "marsh areas", so check this, though the meaning is plausible.
Section 4 Emersed: "it may lose its colours and turn green" became "warnanya bisa memudar dan berubah menjadi hijau" – fine. But "In winter it can only survive indoors" is OK; no change needed.
Section 4: "Liquid fertilizers are required at least a few times a month" became "Pupuk cair wajib diberikan minimal beberapa kali sebulan" – "wajib" is a bit strong; use "perlu".
Section 5: "narrow to broadly elliptic" became "sempit hingga lonjong lebar" – use "elips sempit hingga lebar" for botanical accuracy.

Section 5: "Hardness 1–12 GH" and "Poor growth ... low light, low nutrients" are fine, but "Relocation" as "Pemindahan" is fine. Mistake: "Seeds are disk-shaped" is fine. Main issue: Section 2 "menjadi tumbuhan liar" for "naturalized" should be "ternaturalisasi/menjadi liar" – minor.
Section 2: "British Virgin Islands" as "Kepulauan Virgin Britania Raya" – use the usual "Kepulauan Virgin Britania"; "St. Lucia" should be "Santa Lusia".

alternanthera-reineckii.name: Alternanthera reineckii
notes: Item 9: "the author's view is that this plant requires nutrient-rich substrates" is rendered as a flat statement ("tanaman ini membutuhkan substrat yang kaya nutrisi"). This loses the hedge, though the preceding sentence still says other substrates can work. Soften it, e.g. "sebaiknya/lebih disarankan".
Item 12: "white or blue-pink" became "putih atau biru keunguan hingga merah jambu". This adds "keunguan" and a range, which changes the colour description. Use "putih atau biru-merah jambu".
Item 4: "bogs" as "rawa gambut" is too specific (peat swamp). Use "rawa" or "lahan basah" instead.
Item 12: "Melting" is left in English where Indonesian hobbyists often say "meleleh/rontok". It is acceptable, but a gloss on first use would help.

alternanthera-reineckii-mini.name: Alternanthera reineckii Mini
notes: Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The ID follows that Vietnamese, so check it against the real English original. The ID adds 'Alternanthera reineckii 'Mini'' where the source only says 'Rau dền đỏ mini'. Confirm that the Latin name appears in the original.
Item 2: 'Cây ở đây là cây nuôi cấy mô' is rendered as 'Tanaman ini berupa tanaman kultur jaringan'. It is repetitive. Use 'Tanaman ini merupakan hasil kultur jaringan dalam cup tertutup'.
Item 2: 'Gel nutrisi' for 'thạch dinh dưỡng' is fine, but 'agar nutrisi' is the more common hobby term.
Item 3: the first sentence has no verb ('Tanaman air hasil kultur jaringan dalam cup tertutup'). That matches the English fragment, but a full sentence would read better.
Item 3: 'Intensitas cahaya yang tinggi dan penambahan CO2 membuat pertumbuhan ... lebih baik' is slightly stronger than 'improves'. Use 'dapat meningkatkan pertumbuhan'.
Item 1: 'Tanaman batang (stem)' is fine. Item 1 has no real problems.

ammannia-gracilis.name: Ammania gracilis
notes: Item 8, Flower: "4 kelopak ungu" is botanically imprecise for "petals". Use "4 mahkota bunga ungu" or "4 helai petal ungu".
Item 8, "Teman satu akuarium (tankmate)" is a little wordy. "Tankmate yang cocok" or "Penghuni akuarium yang cocok" is more natural.
Item 8, "itu pun kalau beruntung" adds a casual tone that the English "at best" does not have. Consider "paling-paling hijau biasa".

anubias-barteri.name: Anubias barteri
notes: Item 2: "merambat" for "creeping" is acceptable, but "tidak butuh banyak perawatan" could be "perawatannya mudah" for more natural phrasing.
Item 1: "Kultivar" could be "Kultivar (hasil budidaya)" but this is optional; "rata-rata tinggi" is more natural as "tinggi rata-rata".

anubias-barteri-mini-coin.name: Anubias Mini Coin
notes: "Kecepatan tumbuh" is understandable, but "Laju pertumbuhan" is more standard in plant fact sheets.
"hamparan rapat" for "dense cushion" could be more natural as "rumpun padat berbentuk bantalan".

anubias-barteri-petite.name: Anubias Petite
notes: "tempat daun-daunnya tumbuh" is a bit loose after a comma; better "yang menjadi tempat tumbuhnya daun" to keep it clearly describing the rhizome.
"sampai akarnya menempel kuat" – source says "until it gains a hold"; fine in meaning, but "sampai menempel kuat" is more faithful (rhizome/roots not specified).
"nursery tanaman air Oriental" – consider "pembibitan tanaman akuarium Oriental"; the source says 'aquarium plant nursery', not 'water plant'.
"mudah bercabang" – source "branches well"; acceptable, but "bercabang dengan baik" is closer.
"tidak rewel, dan juga tidak suka cahaya yang terlalu terang" – "high light intensity" is better as "intensitas cahaya tinggi".

anubias-barteri-var-barteri.name: Anubias barteri
notes: "Berimpang (rhizoma)": more usual is "Berakar rimpang (rizoma)" or "Rimpang (rhizome)"; "berimpang" is awkward.
"rimpangnya yang merambat bisa sepanjang 10–15 cm atau lebih": the source says the rhizome is 10-15 cm or more; "bisa" adds slight hedging, minor.

anubias-barteri-var-caladiifolia.name: Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia
notes: Item 1: "Berimpang (rhizoma)" is slightly awkward; hobbyists more often write "Berrimpang" or "Rimpang (rhizome)". Meaning is intact.

Item 2: the source is Vietnamese, not English. The translation is faithful. The only small loss is that "lá tim" (heart-shaped leaf) is dropped and the name is expanded to the full Latin "Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia".

anubias-barteri-var-coffeifolia.name: Anubias Coffeefolia
notes: "Berimpang (rizoma)": "rimpang" is the standard term; "Berimpang" is awkward. Use "Rizoma" or "Berrimpang (rizoma)".
"melengkung cukup dalam di antara tulang-tulang daun": "arch considerably" means the leaf blade bulges or arches between the veins. Use "melengkung/menggelembung cukup jelas di antara tulang daun".
"berukuran pendek" for "low" is acceptable but "rendah" or "bertubuh pendek" is more natural.
"Spesies Anubias tampaknya tumbuh begitu lambat sampai-sampai tidak \"menyadari\"...": slightly wordy. Simplify to "...sehingga seolah tidak sadar bahwa dirinya terendam".

anubias-barteri-var-glabra.name: Anubias Glabra
notes: "Berimpang (rizoma)": "berimpang" is non-standard; use "Berrimpang/Rizoma" or simply "Rizomatosa (berimpang)".
"dipelihara" / "substrat": fine, but "Kalau ditanam di substrat" renders "in the bottom" slightly loosely; consider "di dasar akuarium".
"cahaya yang terlalu terang" is slightly softer than "high light intensity"; consider "intensitas cahaya tinggi".

anubias-barteri-var-nana.name: Anubias nana
notes: "Berrimpang" is an unusual way to label the plant type. Hobbyists more often write "Rizoma" or "Berakar rimpang".
"Asal" in the spec list could read more naturally as "Asal daerah" or "Asal usul". This is optional.

anubias-barteri-var-nana-kirin.name: Anubias Nana Kirin
notes: Item 3: 'inspired by an Asian dragon' — 'Kirin' is a Japanese qilin-like creature, but the source says Asian dragon, so the translation is faithful; no change needed beyond optional smoothing.
Item 3: 'dan inilah yang membedakannya' is slightly wordy; consider 'yang membedakannya dari Anubias lain'.
Item 2: 'Jangan menimbun rimpangnya' is fine, but 'Jangan menutup rimpang dengan substrat' would be more explicit.

anubias-barteri-var-nana-pinto.name: Anubias Nana Pinto
notes: "diikat atau ditempelkan" adds "diikat" (tied) not in the source, which only says "attaching"; minor, but could be simplified to "ditempelkan" or "dipasang".
"Jangan pernah menimbun rimpangnya": "menimbun" (bury) is acceptable, but "menutupi" is closer to the source "cover"; consider "jangan sampai rimpang terkubur/tertutup substrat".
"Kecepatan tumbuh" is fine, but hobbyists more commonly write "Laju pertumbuhan" or "Kecepatan pertumbuhan".
Latin name "Anubias barteri" is not italicized in either source or translation; keep as is, no change needed beyond formatting consistency.

anubias-gracilis.name: Anubias gracilis
notes: "will attain a significant size this way" is rendered "ukurannya akan menjadi cukup besar"; "significant" is stronger than "cukup", so use "cukup besar" -> "jauh lebih besar" or "sangat besar".
"Tanaman air ini kuat dan toleran": "kuat" is a loose rendering of "hardy"; "tangguh" or "mudah dirawat" is more natural.
"Anubias gracilis bisa dibiarkan tumbuh di luar air (emersed)": "emersed" is clunky in brackets; prefer "tumbuh emers" or "tumbuh di atas permukaan air".
"Anubias yang paling elegan": "salah satu Anubias yang paling elegan" is repetitive; "salah satu yang paling elegan" reads smoother.

aponogeton-boivinianus.name: Aponogeton boivinianus
notes: "Kapsul pupuk dasar (root tab)": "Nutrition capsules" is better rendered as "kapsul nutrisi" or "pupuk kapsul"; "root tab" is a different product term, so it adds nuance not in the source.
"lapisan dasar" for "bottom layer" is vague; "substrat dasar" or "pasir/kerikil dasar" is more natural, and use one term consistently with "substrat" in the next clause.
"serta melebar 30–50 cm" is awkward. Say "dengan lebar tanaman 30–50 cm" or "diameter rumpun 30–50 cm"; the source is also a bit unclear, so make it clearly the plant's spread.
"hijau tua pekat" is redundant for "deep dark-green"; "hijau tua" or "hijau gelap" is enough.
"kondisi yang mendukung" is acceptable, but "kondisi yang ideal/optimal" is more natural.
"kadang kecokelatan sampai berkembang sempurna" is slightly clipped; use "sampai daun berkembang sempurna".

aponogeton-longiplumulosus.name: Aponogeton longiplumulosus
notes: "Asal:" is terse; "Asal daerah:" or "Asal wilayah:" reads more naturally in a spec list.
"bergelombang" for "fluted" is acceptable, but "berlekuk/bergerigi bergelombang" would be closer to the ridged leaf edge.

aponogeton-madagascariensis.name: Madagascar Lace
notes: Item 6 'Pembusukan terjadi karena akarnya yang sangat besar': fine, but 'Cleaning the bulb' says 'Crush activated carbon... apply to the treated surface' → 'permukaan yang sudah dibersihkan' is okay; however 'Keeping it at 28 °C can lead to the destruction' was rendered 'rusak dan mati' (added 'dan mati'); use 'bisa menyebabkan tanaman rusak/hancur'.
Item 7 'Memeliharanya pada suhu 28 °C bisa membuat tanaman ini rusak dan mati': 'and mati' is an added claim not in the source.

Item 10 'Corydoras pygmy', 'platy sunburst', 'tetra Buenos Aires': word order is unnatural; use 'Corydoras pygmy' / 'platy sunburst' consistently or 'tetra Buenos Aires' as 'Buenos Aires tetra'. Inconsistent mix of English and Indonesian ordering.
Item 10 'Bila tumbuh hingga di atas permukaan air di akuarium': 'emersed' growth is more naturally 'Bila tumbuh sampai muncul di atas permukaan air'.
Item 10 'lobster air tawar' for crayfish: use 'lobster air tawar (crayfish)' fine, but 'botia (clown loach)' is okay; 'ikan rainbow' should be 'rainbowfish' as hobbyists write.
Item 10 'Jangan biarkan ... Beri pupuk secara rutin' for 'Feed regularly': 'Pasok nutrisi secara rutin' is closer; 'Beri pupuk' narrows the meaning.
Item 10 'Umbi jelek' for 'Bad bulbs': prefer 'Umbi berkualitas buruk'.
Item 8 'diuntungkan dengan pemberian root tab': unnatural; use 'mendapat manfaat dari'.
Item 10 'Daunnya tersusun dari jaringan urat-urat kecil... yang mengurung segmen': 'mengurung' is odd; use 'mengelilingi/membatasi'.

azolla.name: Azolla
notes: Section 6: "salinitas rendah (>8,4 g/l)" keeps the source's ">" sign, which is likely an error in the source too. It is an odd, contradictory claim for 'low salinity'. Check it or use "hingga sekitar 8,4 g/L" if that is what was meant. The sentence "menyerap tembaga berkonsentrasi rendah" in section 7 is fine.
Section 7 tankmates: "white cloud" drops "mountain minnows". Use "white cloud mountain minnow". "corydoras pygmy" has the wrong word order. Use "corydoras kerdil (pygmy corydoras)".
Section 7: "toko online" for "online" is fine. "mas koki" for goldfish is acceptable. "Pilih spesies yang tahan teduh" is awkward. Say "toleran terhadap tempat teduh".

Section 6: "Suhu dingin (−4 °C ke bawah)" and "musim semi" are literal. Indonesian hobbyists have no winter, so consider "musim dingin/musim semi di daerah beriklim empat musim". "mati kembali" for "die back" is unnatural. Use "daunnya mati/layu".

Section 5: "disinfeksi" and "kekurangan oksigen" are fine, but "Pilih tanaman yang tunas dan akarnya berkembang baik" is OK. "Daun busuk" and "gejolak permukaan" are stiff. Use "riak/pergolakan permukaan air".
Section 3: "frond" is left untranslated throughout. Use "daun" or "daun (frond)" at first mention. "lobus dorsal daunnya" is also fine.

bacopa-australis.name: Bacopa australis
notes: "Kebutuhan cahaya: sedang" is fine, but "tanaman batang (stem plant)" could also use the common hobby term "tanaman batang" alone; this is optional and minor.
"merambat di dasar akuarium" is acceptable, but "menjalar" is the more usual term for a plant creeping along the substrate.

bacopa-caroliniana.name: Bacopa caroliniana
notes: "tanaman air akuarium" is slightly redundant; use "tanaman akuarium" or "tanaman air".
"tidak banyak tuntutan" is awkward; use "tidak menuntut banyak" or "perawatannya mudah".
"termasuk sedikit tanaman batang yang tidak perlu banyak perhatian" is clumsy; use "termasuk salah satu dari sedikit tanaman batang yang tidak memerlukan banyak perhatian".

"3–4 cm wide" is translated as "lebar 3–4 cm", which is fine. However, "Batangnya ... lebar" is ambiguous, because stems don't have width. The source is likely about leaves, but keep as is or use "daunnya" only if clear.
"tanam di substrat" for "plant it in the bottom" is acceptable. "dasar akuarium" would be more literal.

bacopa-monnieri.name: Bacopa Monnieri Compact
notes: "Dengan memotong pucuk semua tunas": 'pinching off' is better rendered as 'memangkas pucuk' or 'menjepit/memotong pucuk'; the current phrasing could be read as cutting off whole shoots.
"tanaman ini dengan mudah membentuk banyak tunas samping": 'willingly' is better as 'mudah/aktif'; the phrasing is slightly stiff, so consider 'karena mudah bercabang dengan banyak tunas samping'.
"di bawah naungan tanaman lain": this is fine, but 'tumbuh baik di tempat teduh/ternaungi tanaman lain' reads more naturally.
"tanaman karpet yang agak tinggi": the hobby term 'carpet' is usually 'tanaman karpet/penutup dasar'; consider 'tanaman penutup dasar yang agak tinggi'.
"Kultivar dari tanaman berbatang": 'culture form' means a cultivated form; 'bentuk budidaya' is more literal, but 'kultivar' is acceptable.

bacopa-salzmannii.name: Bacopa Salzmannii Purple
notes: Item 2: "Tanaman air yang tangguh ini" is fine, but "penghobi" for "aquarists" could be "aquascaper/penghobi akuarium"; minor.
Item 3: "Warna ungu yang khas" for "Unique purple coloration" is slightly softer than "unique"; could be "Warna ungu yang unik".

blyxa-aubertii.name: Blyxa aubertii
notes: Item 3: "Biasanya ditemukan di air yang tenang" — the source says "slow" water (slow-flowing), so "tenang" shifts the meaning; use "air mengalir pelan".
Item 9: "halus atau sedikit bergerigi" for "ridged" — "bergerigi" means serrated; use "berusuk/beralur".
Item 5: "melting" is left untranslated in the problems list; add a gloss such as "rontok/meleleh (melting)".

Item 5: "Removing them may turn the annual plant into a perennial" — "mungkin bisa menjadi tanaman tahunan" is hedged twice and "semusim" vs "tahunan" is confusing (annual is semusim, perennial is menahun); use "menahun".
Item 5: "daun yang jelek" for "bad leaves" is too colloquial; use "daun yang rusak".
Item 8: "Lobster air tawar" for crayfish is acceptable, but "botia (clown loach)" and "ikan mas koki" are fine; "burayak" is correct only for fish fry, so check it fits the context.
Item 4: "Itu pun lama-kelamaan" is awkward; use "Bahkan di akuarium sebesar itu, lama-kelamaan tanaman ini bisa menjadi begitu besar...".

blyxa-japonica.name: Blyxa japonica
notes: "biji yang viabel" is stiff jargon; use "biji yang subur/dapat berkecambah".
"Disukai hewan" for "Palatable" is vague; "Dimakan hewan lain" or "Mudah dimakan ikan/siput" is clearer.

bolbitis-heteroclita.name: Bolbitis heteroclita
notes: Section 8, Wilting: 'emergent plants submerged in water wilt because their leaves are not adapted' is rendered 'daunnya belum beradaptasi', which is fine. But 'Turning black ... hard water' is OK. The real problems are elsewhere, listed below.
Section 4: the 80 litres figure is kept, which is correct. The 'setengah emersed' for 'semi-emergent' is fine.
Section 7, Fertilization: 'tanaman ini tetap baik tanpa pupuk rutin' is a loose rendering of 'does fine without regular fertilizers'. Use 'tanaman ini tetap tumbuh baik tanpa pupuk rutin'.
Section 6, 'Di air basa, daun sering terlihat meleleh': 'leaf dissolution' is rendered acceptably, but 'air basa' is better written 'air basa/alkalis'.

Section 8, Tankmates: 'white cloud mountain minnows' becomes 'white cloud' and 'clown killifish' is left in English. 'crystal red shrimp', 'blue bolt shrimp', 'silver dollar' and 'Jack Dempsey' are also left in English. These are acceptable trade names, but 'ikan mas koki' for goldfish should be 'ikan mas' or 'koki'.

Section 8, Avoid: 'crayfish' is rendered 'lobster air tawar', which is correct. 'Soil types: tanah lempung berpasir' for 'loamy soil' is slightly off, since loam is 'tanah lempung/geluh' and not specifically sandy. Use 'tanah lempung (geluh)'.
Section 3: 'tanaman darat peneduh' for 'terrestrial shade plant' is awkward. Use 'tanaman darat yang menyukai naungan'.

Section 2: 'Papua (New Guinea)' narrows New Guinea to Papua, which is a changed fact. Use 'Pulau Papua/Nugini'. The place name 'Kalimantan' for Borneo is also narrower, since Borneo includes Sabah, Sarawak and Brunei. Use 'Borneo'.
Section 5: 'paling hanya beberapa daun per bulan' is awkward. Use 'hanya beberapa daun per bulan'. 'plastik wrap' is better as 'plastik wrap/cling wrap'.

Section 1, 'Bisa ditanam emersed' and 'Growth rate: low' are fine. But 'Aquarium size: 10–15 cm' translated as 'Ukuran di akuarium' is OK. Section 5 contradicts 'Growth rate: low' by saying emersed growth is 'sedang sampai cepat', which matches the source.

bolbitis-heudelotii.name: Bolbitis
notes: Item 1: "Dengan memotong/membagi rizom" adds "memotong" (cutting), which the source doesn't say. Use "Dengan membagi rizom".
Item 6: "leaflets" is translated as "helai daun", which reads as whole leaves. Use "anak daun" or "pinnae", or "daun" if the source means fronds.

bucephalandra.name: Bucephalandra
notes: Item 8: "special odours that attract pollinators" became "aroma khas yang menarik serangga penyerbuk"; "serangga" (insects) is added and not in the source. Use "penyerbuk" only.
Item 6: "Nutrients are stored mainly in the rhizome" is rendered as "Cadangan nutrisi". This is acceptable but could be closer to the source.
Item 6: "hewan pemakan alga" is fine, but "algae eaters" is usually written "hewan pemakan alga (algae eater)" in Indonesian hobby writing. This is minor.
Items 3 and 6: "emersed" and "submersed" are left as English terms with a gloss only once. Use "emers" and "submers", or give a consistent gloss. This is minor.
Item 6: "Another option is to leave the plant in its plastic basket" is rendered as "pot plastiknya". "Pot" is common, but "keranjang/pot jaring" is more precise. This is minor.

bucephalandra-diabolica.name: Bucephalandra Kedagang
notes: "keluarga Bucephalandra": Bucephalandra is a genus, so "marga/genus Bucephalandra" is more accurate than "keluarga" (family); minor.
"varietas Red dari Bucephalandra": consider "varietas Bucephalandra 'Red'" for more natural phrasing; minor.
"Saat terendam": consider "Saat tumbuh terendam (submersed)" for clarity; minor.

bucephalandra-pygmaea.name: Bucephalandra Wavy Green
notes: "aliran air" for streams: "anak sungai" is more natural.
"Tinggi: 5–10+ cm": "5–10 cm atau lebih" reads more naturally.

bucephalandra-sordidula.name: Buce Blue
notes: "Kecepatan tumbuh" is fine but "Laju pertumbuhan" is more standard; optional.
"warnanya makin keluar" is colloquial; prefer "warnanya tampil lebih menonjol" or "warnanya makin cerah".
"Posisi terbaiknya di bagian tengah atau depan akuarium" is slightly awkward; prefer "Paling cocok ditempatkan di area tengah (midground) atau depan (foreground)".

bucephalandra-sp-dark-skeleton-king.name: Bucephalandra Dark Skeleton King
notes: Item 1: "kadang muncul ke permukaan/emers (emersed)" is imprecise. Emersed means growing with leaves above the water, not surfacing. Use "kadang tumbuh di atas permukaan air (emers)".
Item 1: the source spells the genus "Bucephelandra" and the translation silently changes it to "Bucephalandra". The correct spelling is fine, but the Latin name was altered from the source.
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Indonesian is faithful, so there is no translation error, but the source field looks mislabelled.

bucephalandra-sp-degori.name: Bucephalandra Degori
notes: Item 1: The source spells the genus "Bucephelandra", but the translation has "Bucephalandra". The correct spelling is fine, but it is a change to the Latin name, so make sure it is intentional.
Item 1: "emersed (di atas permukaan air)" leaves the English term in place. Use the Indonesian "emers" or "tumbuh di atas permukaan air", with "emersed" in brackets if needed.
Item 2: The source is Vietnamese, not English, so it can't be checked against an English original. The Indonesian follows the Vietnamese closely. Check that the correct source text was supplied.
Item 4: "tempatnya" is too vague for "habitat". Use "habitat" or "akuarium/tempat tumbuhnya" so the advice is clear.
Item 2: "Buce" is a slangy short form. Use "Bucephalandra" at first mention, then "Buce" if wanted.

bucephalandra-sp-mini-melawi.name: Bucephalandra Mini Melawi
notes: Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Indonesian follows it faithfully, but the source should be checked.
Item 1: the source spells it "Bucephelandra" and the translation silently changes it to "Bucephalandra". This is a correct typo fix, so it is only worth confirming.
Item 1: "3 rimpang di foto sebagai perkiraan kasar ukuran porsinya" is slightly clumsy. Consider "foto menampilkan 3 rimpang sebagai perkiraan kasar porsi yang Anda terima".

bucephalandra-sp-needle-leaf.name: Bucephalandra Needle Leaf
notes: "Kecepatan tumbuh" is understandable, but "Laju pertumbuhan" is more natural.
"tetap merupakan tanaman yang sangat mudah dipelihara" is a bit stiff. "tetap tergolong tanaman yang sangat mudah dirawat" reads better.
"antara 1 dan 2 cm" should be "antara 1 dan 2 cm" → "1–2 cm" for more natural phrasing.
"menampilkan warna merah yang cantik" is a bit literal. "berwarna merah yang indah" is more natural.

bucephalandra-sp-red.name: Bucephalandra sp. 'Red'
notes: "Tipe: Berimpang (rhizoma)": "berimpang" is awkward; use "Berrimpang/berakar rimpang (rhizoma)" or simply "Rimpang (rhizome)".
"tumbuh kurang lebih secara epifit": stiff; use "biasanya tumbuh menempel (epifit) pada batu/kayu di dalam atau dekat air".
"merah seperti kulit": ambiguous; use "merah dengan tekstur liat seperti kulit (leathery)".
"tumbuh paling baik di cahaya yang lebih rendah": use "pada pencahayaan yang lebih rendah".
"Pada daun yang tumbuh di bawah air": 'submerse leaves' is better as "daun submersed (terendam)".

bucephalandra-sp-red-cherry.name: Bucephalandra Red Cherry
notes: Item 1: "kadang emersed" leaves the English word bare, while "submersed" is translated and bracketed. Use "terendam (submersed)" and "tumbuh di atas permukaan air (emersed/emers)".

Item 1: the source spells the genus "Bucephelandra" and the translation changes it to "Bucephalandra". This is the correct spelling, so it is only a minor point. Keep the Latin name as the source has it, or apply the same spelling everywhere.
Item 1: "di habitat aslinya kadang tumbuh terendam" is slightly loose. Consider "dapat tumbuh terendam maupun emers, sesuai habitat aslinya".

bucephalandra-sp-round-leaf.name: Bucephalandra Round Leaf
notes: Item 2: the source is Vietnamese, not English, but the ID follows it faithfully, so no translation fault there.

Item 2: 'Bông đá' means rockwool, and 'Membersihkan rockwool' / 'cabuti semua rockwool' is fine. But 'lepaskan saja dari pot' is added: the source says 'gỡ ra', which means take the plant out. It also says 'ngâm riêng trong nước', so 'rendam terpisah di air' is OK.
Item 2: 'Bụi to, thân dày' is rendered as 'Rumpun yang besar dengan batang tebal'. Bucephalandra has rhizomes, so 'batang' should be 'rimpang'.
Item 2: 'hút bớt phân dư' is rendered as 'menyerap kelebihan pupuk'. This is acceptable, but 'nutrisi berlebih' would be more natural.
Item 3: 'Bucephelandra' is misspelled. The genus is Bucephalandra, and the Latin name must be correct. Item 2 uses the right spelling.

Item 3: 'grown submersed and emersed at times from their habitats' is rendered as 'di habitat aslinya tumbuh terendam ... dan kadang-kadang di atas permukaan air'. This is acceptable. 'submersed' and 'emersed' could be given as 'terendam penuh' and 'tumbuh di atas air'.
Item 1: 'Portion' is rendered as 'Jumlah', which is acceptable. 'Porsi' or 'Takaran' would fit better.

bucephelandra-sp.name: Bucephalandra Silver
notes: "emersed (sebagian di atas permukaan air)": the gloss is slightly inexact. Emersed means growing with the leaves above water, so use "emersed (tumbuh di atas permukaan air)".

"Pastikan akuariumnya sudah siap": the source says "habitat", which here means the setup or environment for the plant. "akuarium" is acceptable, but "habitat/lingkungan tumbuhnya sudah siap" is closer.

cabomba-aquatica.name: Cabomba aquatica
notes: Item 2: "Tanaman ini dijual sebagai" adds a sales context that the English doesn't state. Use a neutral phrasing such as "Seikat batang atau tanaman muda yang diikat dengan pemberat".
Item 3: "Di daerah asalnya" narrows "locally" a little. "Secara lokal" or "Di beberapa daerah" would be closer.

caloglossa-beccarii.name: Red Moss
notes: Item 8: "Selain itu, tanaman ini bisa dipelihara bersama udang kerdil" - the source says "In all other cases" (i.e. with fish that don't eat it). Use "Dengan hewan lain, tanaman ini aman dipelihara bersama..." or similar.
Item 6: "<5 pmm" copies the source typo. Write "<5 ppt" or "<5 ppm" consistently, or flag it. Right now it reads as a wrong unit.
Item 10: "diolesi algisida" (smeared with algicide) is an odd choice for "treat". Use "diberi perlakuan algisida" or "dirawat dengan algisida".
Item 10: "Teksturnya terasa sangat lembut" - the source says "very pleasant to the touch", so keep it closer, e.g. "sangat nyaman disentuh".
Item 7: "arus air yang lembut akan optimal bagi Red moss" is awkward. Use "arus air yang lembut paling ideal bagi Red moss".

cardamine-lyrata.name: Cardamine lyrata
notes: Item 2: "lebih kurus dan memanjang, dengan jarak antar-daun yang renggang" adds detail the source doesn't have ("more leggy"). Use a simpler phrase like "lebih kurus dan menjulang/lebih jarang daunnya", or "batang lebih memanjang".
Item 2: "kurus" is an odd word for a plant. Use "batang lebih panjang dan renggang" or "etiolasi".

ceratophyllum-demersum.name: Hornwort
notes: "mirip daun pinus": "pine needles" lebih tepat "jarum pinus".

ceratopteris-thalictroides.name: Water Sprite
notes: Item 3: "daun emersed" translates "surface leaves" with an untranslated English term. Consider "daun di atas permukaan air (emersed)" so it reads more clearly.
Item 4: "Dengan cahaya yang cukup" is weaker than "In good light". "Dengan pencahayaan yang baik" is closer.

crinum-calamistratum.name: Crinum calamistratum
notes: Item 3: "daun hijau tua yang sangat sempit" is slightly awkward for leaves. "sangat sempit" or "sangat ramping/sangat langsing" would read more naturally.
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Indonesian follows it faithfully, but the source should be checked. Its leaf length of 50–75 cm also differs from item 3's 40–120 cm.

crinum-thaianum.name: Crinum thaianum
notes: "Kecepatan tumbuh": more common hobby wording is "Laju pertumbuhan" or "Kecepatan pertumbuhan".
"tidak rewel": slightly colloquial for a plant; consider "tidak menuntut" or "mudah dirawat".

"Crinum thaianum" in the intro: "khas" is vague for "distinctive"; consider "unik" or "khas" with clearer phrasing, e.g. "tanaman berumbi yang khas dari suku lili (Amaryllidaceae)" only if source says so, otherwise keep "keluarga lili".

"memunculkan tangkai bunga sampai ke permukaan air dengan bunga lili yang harum dan anggun": ambiguous; better "tangkai bunga yang mencapai permukaan air dan membawa bunga lili yang harum serta anggun".

cryptocoryne-beckettii.name: Cryptocoryne beckettii 'Petchii'
notes: "Tinggi: 10–15+ cm" is fine, but "Asal" could be "Asal daerah"/"Asal usul" – optional; minor.
"sedikit bergelombang" for "slightly fluted": acceptable, but "bergerigi/berombak halus" may be more precise; minor.
"varietas kecil" could be "varian kecil"; minor.

cryptocoryne-crispatula.name: Cryptocoryne crispatula
notes: "Tanaman ini tidak terlalu rewel": acceptable, but "tidak terlalu menuntut" is more standard in a handbook.
"satu roset tanaman": the source means a single-rosette plant, so "tanaman berroset tunggal" is clearer.
"cup tertutup": use "cup tertutup (kultur jaringan)" or "gelas/wadah tertutup". "cup" is common in the trade, so this is minor.
"merah marun": "maroon" is more commonly rendered as "merah marun/merah kecokelatan". This is fine, but check that it reads naturally.
"Dijual sebagai tanaman air": "aquarium plant" is better as "tanaman akuarium".

cryptocoryne-nurii.name: Cryptocoryne nurii 'Rose Maiden'
notes: "Roset" for Rosulate is fine, but consider "Rosulat" or "Roset (rosulate)" for hobby clarity.
"Laju pertumbuhan: Sedang" is acceptable; "Kecepatan tumbuh" is more common among hobbyists.
"runner (geragih)": consider "sulur" or "stolon", which Indonesian hobbyists use more often, and drop the untranslated English "runner".
"lapisan substrat" for "bottom layer" is fine, but "di bawah substrat" would be more natural.

cryptocoryne-parva.name: Cryptocoryne parva
notes: Item 11, wendtii: "dengan bentuk yang berbeda-beda warna dan bentuk daunnya" is clumsy and repeats "bentuk". Use "dengan varian yang berbeda warna dan bentuk daunnya".
Item 6: "nursery" is left in English. Use "penangkaran" or "tempat budidaya".
Item 11: "harganya beberapa dolar" keeps the dollar currency. Consider "beberapa dolar AS" or a rupiah equivalent for Indonesian readers.

cryptocoryne-spiralis.name: Cryptocoryne Spiralis
notes: Item 3: "Asia" in item 1 is fine, but "commonly found in India" -> "umumnya ditemukan di India" is OK; however "sometimes a less visible green mid-stripe" was rendered as "garis tengah berwarna hijau yang samar" – better: "kadang terdapat garis hijau di tengah daun yang kurang jelas".
Item 1: "Roset" is acceptable, but add "(Rosulate)" or use "Rosulat/Roset" as hobbyists write; Height "20–30+ cm" conflicts with item 3 (over 50 cm) only in the source, keep as is.

Item 2: "good light and nutrition" -> "cahaya yang cukup" weakens "good"; use "cahaya dan nutrisi yang baik". "reach its full potential" -> "tumbuh maksimal" is OK but "tidak sulit dipelihara" better "tidak sulit ditanam/dirawat".

cryptocoryne-undulata.name: Cryptocoryne undulata
notes: "Roset" for Rosulate: acceptable, but "berbentuk roset" would be more natural as a growth-type label.
"Asal: Asia" is slightly terse; "Asal daerah: Asia" or "Asal: Asia" is fine, but "Laju pertumbuhan" could be "Kecepatan tumbuh" as hobbyists more commonly write.
"punya daun" is colloquial for a handbook; use "memiliki daun".
"tumbuh baik di berbagai kondisi" loses "growing"; use "berbagai kondisi budidaya/pemeliharaan".
"satu rosetnya bisa melebar" is slightly awkward; use "satu roset tunggalnya dapat selebar 10–20 cm".

cryptocoryne-usteriana.name: Cryptocoryne usteriana
notes: "geragih (runner)": hobbyists usually say "sulur" or "stolon"; "geragih" is rare, consider "sulur (runner)".
"permukaan bertekstur timbul": slightly awkward; prefer "permukaan bergelombang/berkerut timbul (embossed)".
"sangat tahan terhadap air yang cukup basa": prefer "toleran terhadap air yang cukup basa (alkalin)"; "sangat" modifies tolerance fine but wording is stiff.
"merah marun" for burgundy red is fine but "merah anggur/marun kecokelatan" is closer; minor.
"Asal: Asia": could be "Asal: Asia" fine; "Tinggi: 20–30+ cm" acceptable.

cryptocoryne-wendtii.name: Cryptocoryne wendtii Green
notes: Item 12: 'Also avoid aggressive fish ... Front cichlids' fine, but 'Cryptocoryne wendtii ... crayfish' translated 'lobster air tawar' is OK; main issue: 'The reddish-brown colour is mainly due to anthocyanidin' rendered 'antosianin' (anthocyanin) – minor term shift.

Item 12: 'limb kuning hingga cokelat keunguan dan kerah berwarna cokelat hingga ungu kehitaman' – the English source 'brown to black-purple colour' lacks 'collar'; fine, but 'Mi Oya ... hammered' and 'var. Tropica ... hammered pattern' left English/awkward; use 'bertekstur seperti tempaan' consistently.
Item 8: 'Daun yang terendam tidak perlu dipangkas; ... cabut langsung dari pangkal rimpangnya' – 'cabut' (pull out) for 'remove'; better 'potong/buang dari pangkal'.

Item 8: 'Cryptocoryne wendtii ... tidak bisa diikat ke permukaan keras' – OK; but 'dengan meluruhkan daunnya' – 'by doing so' (not panicking) is mistranslated: the English means that by melting (not panicking), the plant conserves energy; acceptable, but 'Crypto' vs 'crypt' inconsistent.
Item 12: 'Tempat mencari makan: menjadi sumber biofilm' loses 'buffet'; 'nama keren' is too colloquial for 'fancy names' – use 'nama mentereng/eksklusif'.
Item 9: 'neutral pH ... air yang cukup sadah' for 'moderately hard water' fine; but GH range 6–18 vs item 2 GH 8–18 is a source inconsistency, no fix.
Item 10: 'Tanaman ini rakus menyerap nutrisi lewat akar' – 'heavy root feeder' better 'banyak menyerap nutrisi melalui akar (heavy root feeder)'.
Item 12: 'Pada dasarnya spesies udang apa pun' fine; 'rutinlah menjarangkannya' awkward – use 'jarangkan secara rutin'.
Item 3: 'Daftar Merah Sri Lanka' fine; 'nursery (tempat budidaya)' ok.

cyperus-helferi.name: Cyperus helferi
notes: "Kecepatan tumbuh" is fine but "Laju pertumbuhan" is more common in hobby texts; optional.
"tanaman air yang tumbuh terendam" is slightly wordy; "tanaman air sejati/terendam" is more natural.

dracaena-sanderiana.name: Bambu Hoki
notes: Section 5, yellow or soft stalks: "Segera pisahkan dari batang yang masih hijau" omits "Remove it" (cut off/discard the yellow part). "Pisahkan" is ambiguous; use "Buang/potong bagian yang menguning...".
Section 5, fungal diseases: "tanaman bambu terinfeksi jamur tertentu 30-45 hari setelah inokulasi" is clumsy; "specific fungus" is better as "jamur spesifik", and "inokulasi" could be explained.
Section 3: "tetap segar dan hijau sepanjang tahun" adds "sepanjang tahun" (all year), which is not in the source; "evergreen" is better as "selalu hijau".

Section 3: "bright illumination" is rendered as "cahaya terang", but elsewhere the text says moderate, indirect light. This is in the source, but the Indonesian could add "tidak langsung" to avoid contradicting the burn warning.
Section 8: "crayfish" is rendered as "lobster air tawar". This is acceptable, but "uproot" is placed after "eat" and the order changed; the "no-go" translation "sebaiknya jangan digabung" is fine.
Section 7: "Pasir umumnya kurang memiliki sirkulasi udara" is awkward; use "aerasinya buruk / kurang porous".
Section 6: "16–27 °C ideal" is a fragment; use "Suhu ideal 16–27 °C".
Section 2: "tukang kebun berdarah Jerman-Inggris" is stiff; "tukang kebun/ahli hortikultura asal Jerman-Inggris" is more natural. "Clade" as "Klad" is acceptable.

Section 8: "Dracaena spp. ... menghilangkan hingga 87% senyawa organik volatil" is fine, but "Quarantine ... if necessary" follows "bleach for in vitro" without linking context; this is source-faithful.

echinodorus-angustifolia.name: Echinodorus Vesuvius
notes: "Daun-daun emersed ini akan meleleh (melting)": 'melt back' is better rendered as daun lama akan rontok/mati (melt); 'meleleh' is slightly awkward.
"kebun budidaya tanaman": more natural as 'farm tanaman' or 'penangkaran/pembudidaya tanaman air'.
"Banyak menyerap nutrisi lewat akar": 'heavy root feeder' is more natural as 'rakus nutrisi lewat akar' or 'pemakan nutrisi lewat akar (root feeder)'.
"hutan yang meliuk-liuk": 'gnarled' means tangled/twisted; consider 'hutan yang berkelok-kelok dan lebat'.
"Vesuvius cocok masuk kategori yang terakhir": awkward; use 'termasuk dalam kategori terakhir (tekstur unik)'.
"Nama umumnya dipilih": 'common name' is slightly unclear; consider 'Nama populernya'.

echinodorus-aquartica.name: Echinodorus Aquartica
notes: "Kecepatan tumbuh" is fine, but "Laju pertumbuhan" is the more common hobby wording; optional.
"tanaman hias tunggal (soliter)" is slightly redundant; "tanaman solitaire/tunggal" would be more natural.

echinodorus-grisebachii-tropica.name: Echinodorus Tropica
notes: Item 1: "Asal: Kultivar" is slightly awkward; "Asal-usul: Kultivar" or "Origin: Kultivar" reads more naturally.
Item 2: "nursery Tropica" could be "pembibitan/nursery Tropica" (minor).
Item 2: "obovate" is rendered as "bulat telur terbalik", which is fine, but "sempit" and "bulat telur terbalik" together may be clearer as "lanset-bulat telur terbalik" (minor).

echinodorus-ozelot.name: Echinodorus 'Ozelot'
notes: Item 1: "Roset" is acceptable, but "rata-rata tinggi" is slightly awkward; "tinggi rata-rata" is more natural.

echinodorus-red-diamond.name: Echinodorus 'Red Diamond'
notes: "Menambah nutrisi di substrat" is slightly awkward; "Peningkatan nutrisi pada substrat" or "Menambah kandungan nutrisi di substrat" reads more naturally.
"muncul sebagai hasil budidaya" is a bit stiff for "appeared as a culture"; consider "muncul sebagai varietas budidaya" or "hasil kultur".

echinodorus-reni.name: Echinodorus 'Reni'
notes: Item 1: "Reni" dijelaskan sebagai "characterized by being easy to grow"; terjemahan sedikit meratakan nuansa ini, tetapi maknanya masih utuh. Boleh diperjelas, misalnya "dikenal mudah ditanam".
Item 2: "nourishment" diterjemahkan "nutrisi". Ini bisa diterima, tetapi "unsur hara" atau "pupuk" lebih lazim di kalangan hobiis tanaman air.

echinodorus-rose.name: Echinodorus Rosé
notes: "Substrat dasar yang kaya nutrisi" is slightly redundant; "substrat yang kaya nutrisi" is more natural.

"Tanaman air yang cantik ini" adds "air", which the source does not say, but this is harmless. "merah kecokelatan" for "red-brown" is fine, but "bintik-bintik merah kecokelatan" adds "kecil" in the ID text, which is not in the source; remove "kecil" if it was added.

echinodorus-x-barthii.name: Echinodorus Barthii
notes: Item 2: the English source is Vietnamese text, not English. The ID follows the Vietnamese and is faithful to it. Check the source, since the EN field seems to be the wrong text.
Item 2: 'Rumpunnya cukup banyak menghalangi cahaya untuk tanaman rendah' reads awkwardly. Use 'menghalangi cukup banyak cahaya bagi tanaman rendah di bawahnya'.
Item 1: the height is '20–30+ cm', but item 4 says 25–50 cm tall. The source is inconsistent, so check it. The translation itself follows each source.
Item 3: 'Substrat yang bernutrisi' is slightly awkward. Use 'substrat yang kaya nutrisi'.
Item 4: 'Tingginya bisa mencapai 25–50 cm' changes 'becomes 25-50 cm tall'. Use 'Tingginya 25–50 cm'.
Item 4: 'soliter' is a rather formal term. 'Tanaman tunggal/solitaire' is more common among hobbyists.

egeria-densa.name: Elodea densa
notes: "warnanya jadi pucat dan sulur-sulurnya tumbuh kurus": the source says the plant "turns light in colour" (lighter/paler), so "pucat" is acceptable. But "tendrils grow thin" is rendered with "kurus", which is unnatural for plant shoots. Use "menipis" or "tumbuh kecil/tipis". Also "jadi" is informal; use "menjadi".

"Remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2\")": the translation says "Buang daun pada 5 cm bagian bawah batang", which is fine. However "Plant the individual plants ... into the bottom substrate" became "Tanam setiap batang"; it should be "setiap tanaman" to match the source (individual plants, not stems).

"anchor" is rendered as "pemberat (anchor)". The source's anchor is a lead/metal strip that binds the stems, so "pemberat" is okay, but "disatukan dengan pemberat" reads slightly odd; "diikat dengan pemberat (timah)" would be more natural.

"Egeria densa yang tersebar di seluruh dunia ini": "cosmopolitan" means widely distributed, so the meaning is fine. The phrase is a bit long. "Egeria densa yang kosmopolit" or "tersebar luas" would be tighter.

eleocharis-acicularis.name: Hairgrass
notes: "(tersebar di seluruh dunia)" is an added gloss not in the source; harmless but could be removed.
"tanaman air lain" is fine, but "Kalau" is colloquial for a handbook; consider "Jika".

eleocharis-montevidensis.name: Giant Hairgrass
notes: "Tanaman air ini termasuk dasar": mistranslation of "It is basic" — "dasar" is unnatural and unclear; use "tanaman yang sederhana/mudah" or "cocok untuk pemula".
"rumpun-rumpun yang renggang dan tembus pandang": "transparent wads" rendered with added "renggang" (sparse) — not in source; use "rumpun yang tembus pandang/jarang" carefully, remove added detail.
"mudah dirawat" for "low maintenance" is fine, but "Setiap batangnya" for "straw" is OK; "tetap tumbuh dengan bentuk yang terbuka" is slightly awkward — use "mempertahankan pola tumbuh yang terbuka".

"runner (sulur)": keep one term; "sulur" alone or "stolon" is more natural; "bisa ditanam di tempat lain" is ambiguous about what is planted — clarify "tunas/anakan hasil pangkasan bisa ditanam di tempat lain".

eriocaulon-cinereum.name: Eriocaulon cinereum
notes: #4: "temporarily flooded" is rendered "tergenang secara musiman" (seasonally), which slightly changes the meaning. Use "tergenang sementara" or "tergenang untuk sementara waktu".
#2: "Bisa ditanam emersed" leaves the English term bare. Write "Bisa ditanam emers (di atas permukaan air)" or give "emersed" in brackets after the Indonesian term.

eriocaulon-sp-vietnam.name: Eriocaulon Vietnam
notes: "mirip daun pinus": "pine needles" means jarum pinus; use "mirip jarum pinus" (daun pinus is slightly off but meaning is intact).

fissidens-fontanus.name: Phoenix Moss
notes: "punya helaian halus yang rapat berwarna hijau tua": source says "tight deep green down" (fine, dense, down-like growth). "helaian halus" is a loose rendering; consider "bulu halus rapat berwarna hijau tua".
"Moss Fissidens berbentuk seperti bulu ini": a bit awkward; consider "Moss Fissidens yang menyerupai bulu burung ini" (featherlike).
"Moss" as the type is acceptable, but "lumut" is not used for aquarium moss, so keep "moss".

glossostigma-elatinoides.name: Glossostigma
notes: Item 1: "Asal" is slightly awkward as a label; "Asal" alone is okay but "Asal daerah" or "Asal negara" is more natural.
Item 3: "tanaman air terkecil" – the source says aquarium plants; "tanaman akuarium terkecil" is more faithful.
Item 3: "bergaya Jepang" for "Japanese-inspired" is fine, but "banyak dicari" is slightly loose; "sangat diminati" would be more natural.
Item 2: "menaunginya" is a bit stiff; "menutupi/menaungi" is acceptable, but "menutupi" is more common among hobbyists.

gratiola-viscidula.name: Gratiola viscidula
notes: "submersed-nya" leaves English with an Indonesian suffix; use "bentuk terendam" (submersed) instead.
"trimming rutin" is acceptable hobby jargon, but "pemangkasan rutin" is more natural Indonesian.
"tanaman bantalan" for "cushion-plant" is a literal rendering; "tanaman rumpun padat seperti bantal" would be clearer.

helanthium-bolivianum.name: Echinodorus Quadricostatus
notes: "Very light leaves" is translated as "sangat pucat" (very pale); acceptable, but "hijau sangat muda/pucat" would be closer.
"punya", "jadi", "kalau" are colloquial for a handbook; use "memiliki", "menjadi", "jika".

"Previously known as Echinodorus 'Quadricostatus'" is repeated faithfully, but "Sebelumnya dikenal sebagai" is fine; consider "Rosulate" -> "Roset" is OK, so no change needed there. Ensure "geragih" is paired with "stolon/sulur", which hobbyists use more commonly than "geragih".

helanthium-tenellum.name: Helanthium tenellum 'Green'
notes: Item 2: "Tanaman air kecil" – source says "small rosulate plant"; "air" is a minor addition, could be "Tanaman kecil berbentuk roset".
Item 2: "tidak banyak tuntutan" is slightly stiff; more natural: "tidak rewel" or "tidak menuntut".
Item 2: "lapisan substratnya kaya nutrisi" is acceptable, but "bottom layer" could be "dasar akuarium yang kaya nutrisi".

heteranthera-zosterifolia.name: Heteranthera
notes: Item 7: "Long aerial roots may appear" -> "Akar udara yang panjang bisa muncul" is fine, but "Leggy bottom leaves" is rendered "Bagian bawah gundul"; ok. Real issue: "hard and/or alkaline water" -> "air sadah dan/atau basa" fine. Main issue is in item 9: "the plant grows thin and leggy" -> "kurus dan gundul di bagian bawah" changes meaning (leggy = stretched/etiolated, not bare at bottom); use "kurus dan memanjang/kurus kering".
Item 9: "without it the plant looks flaccid, leggy and stretched" -> "lemas, gundul di bawah, dan memanjang": "leggy" mistranslated as "gundul di bawah"; use "lemas, kurus, dan memanjang".
Item 12: "otherwise it melts or becomes leggy" -> "gundul di bagian bawah" narrows the meaning; use "menjadi kurus dan memanjang".
Item 10: "Crayfish" -> "Lobster air tawar" is acceptable, but "goldfish" -> "ikan mas koki" is slightly off; use "ikan mas/koki". "Heteranthera ... docile" -> "tenang" ok.
Item 10: "clown loaches" -> "botia (clown loach)" is OK; "killifish" and "otocinclus" are left untranslated in English form, fine but consider "ikan killi".
Item 6: "Water roots" -> "Akar air" is a literal rendering; "Bagian ini" is vague for "Those" (the roots); use "Akar ini mudah dipotong".

hydrocotyle-tripartita.name: Hydrocotyle tripartita 'Japan'
notes: "penghambatan mekanis" for "mechanical retardation" is a bit stiff; consider "pemangkasan/penekanan mekanis" or keep the English term in brackets.

hydrocotyle-verticillata.name: Hydrocotyle verticillata
notes: Item 10: "swordtails" is rendered "platy pedang (swordtail)" — a swordtail is not a platy (different species, Xiphophorus hellerii vs. X. maculatus); use "swordtail" or "ekor pedang".

Item 10: "Japanese trapdoor snail", "Malaysian trumpet snail", "black devil snail" and "rabbit snail" are left in English; give local names (e.g. keong/siput trumpet Malaysia, siput kelinci) or keep them in brackets after the Indonesian term. "ghost shrimp", "bamboo shrimp" and "vampire shrimp" are also left untranslated.
Item 10: "ikan mas koki" is redundant/mixed; goldfish is "ikan mas" or "koki" ("ikan koki"). Also "koi" is fine, but "Jack Dempsey" may need "ikan Jack Dempsey".
Item 10: "sepat mutiara" for pearl gourami is fine, but "platy" and "cichlid" appear untranslated, while "lobster air tawar" is used for crayfish; consider making terms consistent.
Item 7: "CO2 berlimpah secara gratis" is an awkward rendering of "free excess CO2"; use "kelebihan CO2 alami" or "CO2 berlimpah tanpa injeksi".
Item 7: "tanaman rambat seperti tanaman rambat" style repetition: "Pertumbuhannya yang merambat seperti tanaman rambat" is redundant; use "pertumbuhannya yang menjalar seperti sulur".

Item 11: "tanaman hias dalam ruangan" for "indoor plant" is acceptable, but "trailing growth form" and "3-7 cm" conflict with other sections of the source, which is not a translation fault. Item 12: "Menyediakan biofilm sebagai pakan pertama" is fine.

hygrophila-angustifolia.name: Hygrophila angustifolia
notes: Item 5: "Pinching stem tips" translated as "Memotong ujung batang (pucuk)" is fine, but "Regular propagation by trimming and replanting stems" became "Memperbanyak secara rutin dengan memangkas..." with no subject; reads awkward and ambiguous.

Item 5: "at least three nodes" is rendered correctly, but "Do not allow it to grow above the surface" conflicts with the earlier emersed info; no issue. However "Leggy growth" translated as "kurus memanjang (leggy)" is fine; "Relocation ... uproot a large part of the tank" became "mengangkat sebagian besar isi akuarium", which changes the meaning (it uproots plants and substrate, not tank contents). Use "mencabut sebagian besar tanaman/substrat di akuarium".
Item 7: "It is a heavy root feeder" rendered as "rakus menyerap nutrisi lewat akar". Acceptable, but "feeds from the water column" as "menyerap makanan" is imprecise; use "menyerap nutrisi".
Item 8: "Flowers: petals usually white" translated as "kelopaknya" (sepals/calyx). Should be "mahkota bunga" (petals).
Item 8: "Stems: hard" described as "keras" but the plant is called "berbatang lunak (herba)" in the first bullet, a contradiction. Use "berbatang basah/herba" or "tidak berkayu".
Item 8: "Quarantine ... quarantine and disinfect it" uses a noun-like "karantina dan disinfeksi tanaman", which is awkward. Use "karantina dan disinfeksi dahulu tanaman" or "lakukan karantina...".
Item 2: "Papua (New Guinea)" for New Guinea narrows the region to Indonesian Papua. Use "Nugini" / "Papua Nugini" as appropriate.
Item 8: "fry" given as "burayak", acceptable, but "Fast growth lets it absorb ammonia, nitrates" — the study figures lack units, left unchanged; fine.

hygrophila-corymbosa.name: Hygrophila corymbosa
notes: Item 2: 'potong pucuknya lalu tanam ulang' repeats 'pucuknya' in two consecutive clauses; could be smoother, e.g. 'potong pucuknya lalu tanam kembali'.
Item 2: 'Sangat tangguh' in item 1 is fine, but 'jadi' in 'daunnya jadi hijau kebiruan' is colloquial for a handbook; 'menjadi' is more suitable.

hygrophila-costata.name: Hygrophila costata
notes: "jadi daunnya lebih bulat": the added "jadi" makes a causal link that the English does not state. Use "dan daunnya lebih bulat" or "serta berdaun lebih bulat".
"(emersed)": this is an added English gloss. It is acceptable, but "emers" or "di atas permukaan air" alone is more natural.

hygrophila-difformis.name: Water Wisteria
notes: Item 4: "Plant the individual plants with some distance between them into the bottom substrate" is fine, but the English "remove the leaves from the lowest 5 cm (2\")" is converted OK; the real problem is "ikan lain yang sensitif" for "shrimps and other delicate fish" – fine, but "Tanaman ini dijual sebagai satu ikat ... dijepit dengan pemberat (anchor)" adds "dijual"/"dijepit"; better: "diikat dengan pemberat/penjepit timah".
Item 7: "berbentuk seperti bulu dengan lebar hingga 10 cm" is unclear; say "helai daun seperti bulu burung (feathery fronds) selebar hingga 10 cm".
Item 7: "Water wisteria vs. water sprite" heading left in English; translate (e.g. "Water wisteria vs. water sprite (Ceratopteris)" with Indonesian: "Water wisteria dan water sprite: apa bedanya").
Item 7: "Daun emersed ... lebih lebar" fine, but "kebun komersial" for "commercial farms" should be "pembudidaya/kebun komersial" – acceptable; "kekurangan nutrisi" for "starvation" OK.
Item 5: "Peralihan dari emersed ke submersed" and "kesadahan (GH) rendah" fine; "boleh dibuang" for "you can remove them" is okay but "sebaiknya dibuang" is more natural.
Item 5: "leggy" translated as "terlalu panjang kurus"; use "memanjang dan jarang daunnya (etiolasi)".
Item 3: "countries ranging between India and Thailand" -> "Berasal dari negara-negara di antara India dan Thailand" – 'kawasan' is slightly redundant.
Item 6: "lobed leaves ... distinctive group" -> "kelompok yang khas" is vague; say "rumpun yang mencolok".

hygrophila-lancea-araguaia.name: Hygrophila lancea 'Araguaia'
notes: "Pemangkasan pucuk batang": acceptable, but "pemangkasan pucuk" alone is more natural for pinching.
"banyak tanda yang menunjukkan" is slightly literal; "ada banyak indikasi" reads more natural.

hygrophila-odora.name: Hygrophila odora
notes: Minor: "tanaman hijau" in "mengisi area tengah atau belakang dengan tanaman hijau" could be "tanaman" or "warna hijau"; "greenery" is better rendered as "hijauan".
Minor: "vibrant" is rendered as "segar", which repeats "fresh" later; "subur/semarak" would be more varied.

hygrophila-pinnatifida.name: Hygrophila pinnatifida
notes: Item 2: "Pertumbuhannya sedang" conflicts with the later "lambat sampai sedang"; this repeats the English inconsistency, so it is acceptable, but "dipangkas" for "pinched out" could be "dipotong/dipangkas pucuknya" (minor).
Item 3: "cup tertutup" leaves "cup" in English; use "cup/wadah tertutup" or "pot tertutup" (minor).
Item 3: "Daunnya berwarna cokelat dengan bercak-bercak di permukaan atas" adds "atas" (upper side). The English says only "on the surface"; use "di permukaan" (minor).

hygrophila-polysperma.name: Hygrophila polysperma
notes: "mapan di Kentucky" is stilted; use "menetap/berkembang biak di Kentucky".
"perairan yang hangat karena panas (bukan kondisi alami)" is awkward; use e.g. "perairan yang dihangatkan secara buatan (tidak alami)".
"menjadi liar" for "naturalized" is imprecise; "ternaturalisasi" or "menyesuaikan diri dan berkembang biak di alam" is clearer.
"jadi kurus tinggi" for "leggy" is unnatural; hobbyists say "etiolasi" or "batang memanjang dan jarang daun".
"meski bisa menyerap nutrisi dari mana saja" is looser than "versatile feeder"; use "dapat menyerap nutrisi lewat daun maupun akar".
"Tanaman ini juga tercatat" adds "juga" that is not in the source; drop it.

hygrophila-serpyllum.name: Hygrophila serpyllum
notes: Item 2: "Laju pertumbuhannya yang tidak terlalu cepat" is a slight rewording of "manageable growth rate"; it is acceptable, but "mudah dikendalikan" would be closer.
Item 2: "tumbuh subur dengan pencahayaan sedang" leaves out the subject after "Perawatannya mudah", so the sentence reads slightly choppy. Use "tanaman ini tumbuh subur ...".

juncus-repens.name: Juncus repens
notes: "Juncus repens berkembang biak dengan mudah": the source says "proliferates"; fine, but "tanaman batang (stem)" for 'Growth form: stem' is okay. Hard-to-read bits: "tumbuh berumpun" for "cespitose" is acceptable.
"Celestial Pearl danio (galaxy rasbora)": the bracket adds a name not in the source; keep just "Celestial Pearl danio" (or "Danio margaritatus") for consistency.
"rawa gambut" for "bogs" is too specific (peat swamp); use "rawa asam" or "lahan basah"/"bog".
"Tanaman ini hanya tahan cahaya rendah yang mendekati batas atasnya": awkward; rephrase to "hanya tahan cahaya rendah pada kisaran paling terang dari kategori rendah".
"rakus menyerap nutrisi lewat akar" for "heavy root-feeder": use the standard "root feeder yang rakus (heavy root feeder)".
"Tidak alelopati: ... tidak terlalu bersifat alelopati": use "Tidak bersifat alelopati" and phrase naturally.
"burayak ikan": 'burayak' is correct, but for hobbyists "anakan ikan" is more common.
"akuarium nano mungkin hanya bisa dilakukan di tank low-tech": mixing "tank" and "akuarium"; use "akuarium low-tech" consistently (also in "pupuk cair bersifat opsional di tank low-tech").
"Kepiting air tawar dan lobster air tawar": "crayfish" is more commonly "lobster air tawar"; ok, but "menjalani siklus nitrogen" for 'cycling' is fine.

lagenandra-meeboldii.name: Lagenandra meeboldii Red
notes: "Tanaman air ini": the English says only "This plant". Use "Tanaman ini" (minor addition).
"hijau kusam dengan ungu terang": "dusty green with bright violet" is slightly unclear. Consider "hijau kusam keunguan terang" or "hijau kusam dengan semburat ungu cerah".

leptodictyum-riparium.name: Stringy Moss
notes: "tree roots" diterjemahkan "akar kayu"; lebih tepat "akar pohon" (atau "kayu apung/bogwood" jika dimaksud), meski "akar kayu" lazim di hobi.
"Growth is both vigorous and rapid" menjadi "lebat dan cepat"; "lebat" kurang pas untuk "vigorous", pertimbangkan "kuat dan cepat".
"brood care and cover" diterjemahkan "tempat perlindungan bagi anakan serta tempat bersembunyi"; agak redundan, cukup "tempat berlindung dan perawatan anakan ikan".

lilaeopsis-brasiliensis.name: Lilaeopsis brasiliensis
notes: Minor: "efek karpet rumput" is fine, but consider the hobby term "hamparan/karpet" consistently; optional.
Minor: "Stolon" type could be "Stolon (menjalar)" - optional only.

limnobium-laevigatum.name: Amazon Frogbit
notes: Item 4: "cup tertutup" leaves English "cup" in place; "cangkir/wadah tertutup" or "cup (wadah) tertutup" would be more natural. This is minor.
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The translation is faithful and I found no meaning errors.

limnophila-aquatica.name: Limnophila aquatica
notes: Item 3: "circled by light-green and finely branched leaves" is rendered as leaves arranged in whorls around the stem ("tersusun melingkar mengelilingi batang"). This is an interpretation. Keep it closer to the source, e.g. "dikelilingi daun hijau muda yang bercabang halus", or use the standard term "berkarang" for whorled leaves.
Item 3: "beberapa batang ditanam berkelompok dalam satu grup kecil" is redundant ("berkelompok" and "grup kecil"). Use "ditanam dalam kelompok kecil".
Item 2: "substrat dasar yang kaya nutrisi" is slightly redundant. "Substrat yang kaya nutrisi" is enough.

Item 2: "each stem up to 15 cm wide" is translated as "lebar tiap batang sampai 15 cm". This is ambiguous, since a stem does not have a width of 15 cm. The source is also odd, so keep the meaning but consider "lebar rumpun".

limnophila-aromatica.name: Limnophila aromatica
notes: Item 1: "dipakai sebagai daun aromatik" – source says aromatic herb; use "herba/sayuran beraroma" or "bumbu" instead of "daun aromatik".

Item 1: "diameter antara 5 dan 6 cm" is faithful but the original is odd (likely stem/cluster width); acceptable, but "Bentuk emersed/submersed" could use "emers/submers" or Indonesian terms "tumbuh di atas air / terendam".
Item 2: "Potong batang tepat di ruas" – "agak jauh di bawah tinggi akhir" is a bit awkward; clearer: "Potong batang pada ruas yang berada cukup jauh di bawah tinggi akhir yang diinginkan".
Item 2: "kemiringan yang cantik" – "slope" is better as "kontur miring yang rapi"; "cantik" is slightly off.
Item 2: "tahan terhadap naungan oleh dirinya sendiri" is clumsy; use "tahan terhadap saling menaungi antar-batang (self-shading)".
Item 3: "Nitrat rendah membuat ... jauh lebih merah" fine; "Pilih varietas" fine. "Spektrum cahaya merah/biru yang lebih kuat" is OK.

limnophila-hippuridoides.name: Limnophila hippuridoides
notes: Item 2: "tumbuh sangat cepat" overstates the source: "vigorously growing" is closer to "tumbuh subur/kuat", and item 1 says the growth rate is medium (sedang), so this contradicts it.
Item 2: "dijarangkan" is slightly awkward for "thinning". Use "dipangkas/dikurangi" for clarity.
Item 3: "Tanaman ini mudah dirawat" renders "A simple plant". It is acceptable but could be "tanaman yang tidak rewel".

limnophila-sessiliflora.name: Ambulia
notes: Item 9: "Pendapat ini tidak sepenuhnya disetujui" softens the English "does not agree". Use a neutral, firm phrasing such as "Pendapat ini tidak sesuai dengan pengamatan: ...".
Item 10: "bergerigi atau bergerigi tajam" repeats the same word. Use "bergerigi atau bergerigi kasar/berduri halus", or "bergerigi" and "bergigi" for jagged/serrated.

lindernia-rotundifolia.name: Lindernia rotundifolia
notes: "mungkin perlu dipangkas sesekali": "sesekali" (occasionally) is added; the English only says "may require some pruning". Use "mungkin perlu dipangkas".
"sungai kecil" for "streams" is fine, but "as a solitary mid-ground plant" is slightly loose; "soliter" is acceptable, though "tunggal" is more natural.

littorella-uniflora.name: Littorella uniflora
notes: Item 2: the English source is actually Vietnamese text (not English), so the source does not match the expected original; the ID is a translation of Vietnamese. Verify the source pairing.

Item 2: 'lakukan perawatan akuarium dengan hati-hati' is fine, but the item adds/omits content relative to the item 3 source (e.g. 'tách thành từng cụm' and 'phủ kín' are not in the English); confirm the correct source.
Item 3: 'Tahan dengan intensitas cahaya yang cukup rendah' is awkward; use 'Toleran terhadap intensitas cahaya yang cukup rendah'.
Item 3: 'runners' translated as 'stolon' is acceptable, but 'sulur' could be used; 'fat and fleshy' is rendered 'tebal berdaging' dropping 'fat' (minor).

lobelia-cardinalis.name: Lobelia cardinalis
notes: "Tanaman ini tahan air yang sangat sadah tetapi tidak menyukainya" is awkward; use "mentoleransi air sangat sadah, tetapi kurang menyukainya".
"busuk pucuk (crown rot)": crown rot is more accurately "busuk mahkota/pangkal batang". "Pucuk" means shoot tip, which is a different part of the plant.
"Bentuk emers" and "stek batang yang sudah dewasa": "emers" is a rare term. Use "emersed" or "tumbuh di atas air" consistently, not only in the first mention.
"Kecepatan tumbuh" is less common than "laju pertumbuhan" or "kecepatan pertumbuhan".
"si cardinal flower": "si" is odd for a plant. Use "yang dikenal sebagai cardinal flower".
"latar depan / latar tengah": hobbyists usually say "foreground/midground" or "bagian depan/tengah akuarium".
"pupuk tablet akar": "tablet akar (root tab)" is the usual term. Drop "pupuk" before it.
"Teman satu akuarium": "tank mate" is better rendered "Ikan penghuni bersama" or "Kompatibilitas". "Membeli" is also abrupt; use "Tips membeli".

ludwigia-arcuata.name: Ludwigia arcuata
notes: Item 1: "Ludwigia daun jarum" is not in the English "Other names" list. Remove it, or leave it out unless it is an established local name.
Item 2: "sekitar 5–10 cm" renders "a few inches" a little loosely. "sekitar 5–8 cm" is closer.

ludwigia-brevipes.name: Ludwigia brevipes
notes: "a few inches below" became "beberapa sentimeter" – vague but acceptable; better give an approximate figure, e.g. "sekitar 5–8 cm".
"Pemangkasan sebaiknya dibuat miring, makin rendah ke arah depan" adds detail not in source ("sloped to the front"); rephrase more literally, e.g. "miring ke arah depan".
"dengan percabangan dan warna yang lebih sedikit": coloration is lessened, not fewer; use "percabangan lebih jarang dan warna lebih pudar".
"Laju pertumbuhannya sedikit lebih sedang dibanding tanaman yang tumbuh lebih cepat" is awkward; use "laju pertumbuhannya sedang, sedikit lebih lambat dibanding...".
"kontras dengan baik terhadap" is unnatural; use "berkontras indah dengan".
"tanaman ini juga cukup tahan ditanam terlalu rapat" is awkward; use "cukup toleran terhadap tanaman yang terlalu rapat".
"rumpun yang lebih rimbun" and "lebih kurus" for "thinner" – use "lebih jarang/ramping"; "defisiensi" should be "kekurangan nutrisi".
"Tanaman batang" for stem plant is fine, but "air sadah" for hard water is OK; "tangguh" for hardier – prefer "lebih mudah dirawat/tahan".

ludwigia-glandulosa.name: Ludwigia glandulosa
notes: Item 2: "5-12 cm wide" is rendered "lebar 5–12 cm" faithfully (the source's odd figure is preserved), so there is nothing to fix. Optionally use "Batangnya bisa tumbuh setinggi..." for smoother phrasing.
Item 1: "tanaman batang (stem)" is acceptable, but "Jenis: tanaman batang" is enough; the bracketed English is optional.

ludwigia-palustris.name: Ludwigia palustris 'Super Green'
notes: Item 3: "Tanaman ini termasuk tanaman batang" is repetitive; use "Ini termasuk tanaman batang (stem plant)" or similar.
Item 3: "Warna merah dan hijau muda keduanya akan saling menonjolkan secara visual" is awkward; use "Warna merah dan hijau muda akan saling menonjolkan".
Item 2: "Setiap batang tumbuh dengan lebar 2–4 cm" is slightly unnatural; the width refers to the leaves/whorl, so consider "lebar 2–4 cm" phrased more naturally.

ludwigia-repens.name: Ludwigia repens 'Rubin'
notes: "Tanaman ini tidak banyak tuntutan" is a bit stiff; more natural: "Tanaman ini tidak rewel / mudah dirawat".
"Panjang batang 20–50 cm dengan lebar 4–6 cm": fine in meaning, but "lebar" most likely refers to leaf/stem spread; consider "lebar rumpun" for clarity if the source means that.
"Asal" for Origin is okay but "Asal daerah" or "Asal usul" is more natural in a handbook.

lysimachia-nummularia.name: Creeping Jenny
notes: Section 4: "jadi melihat ukurannya, akuarium minimal sekitar 40 liter" is awkward; use "mengingat ukurannya, akuarium minimal sekitar 40 liter".
Section 9: "batang yang menjalar di permukaan tanah" is stiff; "batang menjalar" or "batang yang merunduk/merayap" is more natural.
Section 5: "Akar yang tidak sedap dipandang" is a little odd for "Ugly roots"; "Akar kurang estetis" or "Akar tampak kurang rapi" is better.

Sections 1, 5 and 8: "emersed" and "submersed" are left in English without a local equivalent. Add "(di atas permukaan air)" or "(terendam)" at first mention, and use "terendam" consistently. Section 9 mixes "emersed" with "terendam".
Section 9: "Bunga kuning yang biasanya bermahkota 5 helai" is okay but stiff; "berkelopak 5" or "berpetal 5" is more common.
Section 5: "Pertumbuhan memanjang (leggy)" is slightly vague; "batang melar/kurus memanjang" would be clearer.
Section 1: "Area tengah dan belakang" is fine, but hobbyists usually say "bagian tengah dan belakang akuarium".

lysimachia-parvifolia.name: Lysimachia parvifolia 'Red'
notes: "tanaman air berwarna hijau" for "green aquarium plant": better "tanaman akuarium berwarna hijau" ("tanaman air" is broader and less precise).
"sehingga tanaman ini menjadi tanaman aksen": repetitive "tanaman"; consider "menjadi aksen yang menarik".
"memberikan perkembangan warna terbaik": slightly stiff; consider "menghasilkan warna terbaik".

marsilea-hirsuta.name: Marsilea hirsuta
notes: Item 2: "Count Luigi Ferdinando Marsilea" leaves the title "Count" in English; use "Conte" or "Graf/Count (bangsawan)", or drop the title.
Item 2: "dinamai dari" is unnatural; use "dinamai menurut" or "dinamai untuk menghormati".
Item 8: "hijau limau" is an odd rendering of "lime-green"; "hijau terang/hijau limau muda" reads more naturally.
Item 8: "rainbow" for rainbowfish is ambiguous; use "ikan pelangi (rainbowfish)".
Item 8: "Endler" alone is incomplete; use "guppy Endler" or "Endler's livebearer".

mayaca-fluviatilis.name: Mayaca fluviatilis
notes: "Tidak ada jaminan bahwa tanaman ini bebas dari pestisida" drops the actor of the English "We are unable to guarantee"; better "Kami tidak dapat menjamin" rendered neutrally, e.g. "Produsen tidak dapat menjamin...". Meaning is slightly weakened.

"Tanaman dijual sebagai ikatan batang..." adds a claim (sold as) not in the English "A bundle of stems or young plants gathered in an anchor"; also "anchor" is rendered as "pemberat" (weight), which is acceptable but "ikatan/pengikat (anchor)" would be closer.
"di nursery milik produsennya sendiri" replaces "Tropica's own nursery"; fine as neutral, but "nursery" should be "pembibitan/kebun produksi" for natural Indonesian.
"Tinggi: 15–30+ cm" and "Jenis" are fine; "udang dan ikan lain yang sensitif" changes "shrimps and other delicate fish" slightly (shrimp are not fish, but it follows the source).

micranthemum-callitrichoides.name: HC Cuba
notes: Item 3: the English source is not English but Vietnamese; the ID itself is faithful to it, but the original lacks an English counterpart, so check the source alignment (the source mentions 'rễ sẽ chết dần' = roots die gradually, which is rendered correctly).
Item 1: 'Asal' for Origin is a bit non-standard; use 'Asal daerah' or 'Asal usul'. Minor.
Item 4: 'tidak serewel itu' is colloquial for a handbook; use 'tidak terlalu menuntut'. Minor.
Item 4: 'Pangkas karpetnya secara rutin, kalau tidak bagian bawahnya...' is a comma splice; use 'karena jika tidak,' or 'jika tidak,'. Minor.
Item 2: 'Ditemukan di Kuba' - 'Found on Cuba' is fine; no change needed except to consider 'ditemukan di Pulau Kuba'.

micranthemum-glomeratum.name: Pearl Grass
notes: "Tanaman karpet" is acceptable, but "tanaman latar depan" could be written "tanaman latar depan (foreground)" for clarity; minor.
"Asal" in the spec list is slightly terse; "Asal daerah" or "Asal negara/benua" reads more naturally; minor.

micranthemum-tweediei.name: Micranthemum tweediei
notes: "Aquarist punya dua pilihan" leaves 'Aquarist' in English; use "Penghobi akuarium" or "Aquascaper".
"pearling" is left untranslated; add the local term, e.g. "mengeluarkan gelembung oksigen (pearling)".
"per helai" / "Helaiannya" for 'strands' is slightly awkward; "batang" or "stek" is more natural for stem plants.
"menarik alga" (attract algae) is a little literal; "mengundang alga" is more natural.
"tahan air sadah" is fine, but "Tanam dalam rumpun sekecil yang bisa Anda tangani" is slightly stiff; "sekecil yang masih nyaman Anda tanam" reads better.

micranthemum-tweediei-monte-carlo.name: Monte Carlo
notes: Item 3: "compact, round ... leaves" is translated as "kecil, bulat". This changes "compact" to "small". Use "padat/rapat" or "kompak", or drop the size claim.
Item 2: "Daun lama yang menguning adalah bagian tanaman yang awal" is stiff. Say something like "merupakan bagian tanaman dari awal tanam" or "daun bawaan awal".
Item 2: "Biarkan saja di minggu-minggu pertama" is a loose rendering of "leave it alone". "Jangan diganggu dulu di minggu-minggu pertama" would be clearer.
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English, so it could not be checked against an English original. The Indonesian follows the Vietnamese meaning and numbers.

micranthemum-umbrosum.name: Micranthemum umbrosum
notes: "Kebutuhan cahayanya relatif tinggi": the English says "Relatively demanding in terms of light", which fits. But item 1 lists light demand as "Sedang", so the two entries are slightly inconsistent. This comes from the source, so keep the wording but check it.
"pucuknya harus sering dipangkas": "pinched out" means the shoots are pinched off. "dipangkas" (trimmed) is acceptable, but "dipotong/dipetik" or "dijepit" would be closer.
"tanaman air cantik dari Amerika Serikat": the English says "US". Item 1 gives the origin as Amerika Utara. This is a source discrepancy, so the translation is faithful. The added "air" is harmless.

microsorum-pteropus.name: Java Fern
notes: Item 5: "It does best with a 6700K bulb. Low to medium-high light is perfect" is fine, but "Cahaya rendah sampai sedang-tinggi sudah ideal" is awkward; use "cahaya rendah hingga sedang-terang".
Item 3: "tekan tanaman ke lem selama 30 detik" is fine, but "oleskan setitik lem" (bead of glue) is slightly off; "teteskan sedikit lem" is better.

Item 3: "jangan sembarangan memulai akuarium dengan tanaman ini" misses the meaning. It should say not to start a new tank with this plant alone, because algae can overwhelm it. As written, the advice is ambiguous.
Item 3: "cabut beberapa helai daun" and "ambil tunasnya dan mulai tanam lagi" are acceptable, but "cabut" (uproot) is less apt for leaves; use "lepaskan" or "patahkan".
Item 8: "pendiri perusahaan yang mengembangkannya" replaces the name "Tropica". Tropica is a trade name hobbyists know, so the source name was dropped without need. Use "pendiri Tropica".
Item 4: "Tanaman ini tidak dimakan ikan herbivora" is an absolute claim. Keep the original's sense, but "biasanya tidak dimakan" would be safer.
Item 5: "lupa menyimpannya di ember" is fine, but "Hampir semua jenis lampu" (almost any light) is acceptable. "akuaris" is an uncommon term in Indonesia; use "aquascaper" or "hobiis akuarium".

microsorum-pteropus-narrow.name: Java Fern Narrow
notes: Item 2: the English source is actually Vietnamese, not English. The translation is faithful to it, but flag the source-language mismatch to the pipeline owner. Fix the source text if this is an error.

Item 1: 'berrimpang (rhizome)' is not standard. Use 'berimpang (rhizoma)' or 'berrimpang' consistently with 'rimpang' in the other items. 'Jenis' for 'Type' (growth type) is acceptable, but 'Tipe' is clearer.
Item 2: 'Java Fern Narrow' is left in English with a wrong word order. Use 'Paku Jawa (Java Fern) Narrow' or 'Microsorum pteropus Narrow'.
Item 2: 'midground' is left untranslated. Use 'tanaman area tengah (midground)'.
Item 2: 'ikat pelan-pelan' loses the meaning of 'lightly'. Use 'ikat longgar' or 'ikat dengan lembut'.
Item 2: 'rimpang mudah membusuk perlahan' adds 'perlahan', which the source only implies. Use 'mudah membusuk'.
Item 3: 'varietas baru mudah dibiakkan' is fine, but 'sudut yang tidak selancip' is awkward. Use 'sudut yang kurang tajam'.

Item 3: 'Daunnya bisa mencapai 10–20 cm dan rimpangnya 10–15 cm' is fine, but the final sentence fragment 'Tanaman yang dekoratif dan juga cocok...' is better as 'Tanaman hias yang juga cocok untuk akuarium yang lebih kecil.'

microsorum-pteropus-trident.name: Java Fern Trident
notes: Item 2: "New, small plants ... on the leaf tips" translated as "Tunas-tunas kecil"; acceptable, but "tanaman baru" is closer. Minor.

Item 1: "Berimpang (rhizoma)" is odd. Use "Berrimpang (rhizoma)" or "Rizoma". Minor.

Item 3: "bercabang tiga" for tripartite is slightly loose. "berlekuk/terbagi tiga" is more accurate. Minor.

microsorum-sp.name: Microsorum sp.
notes: "Berimpang (rimpang/rhizome)": awkward; use "Berrimpang (rhizomatous)" or simply "Berrimpang" (the standard Indonesian form is "berrimpang", not "berimpang"), and avoid the slash gloss.
