"Tanamannya bisa berupa satu Anubias ... dan satu Microsorum": the Latin genus names are correct, but consider italics or the "Anubias barteri var. caladiifolia" format to make clear they are plant names.

monosolenium-tenerum.name: Monosolenium
notes: Item 10: "percaya bahwa ia sebagian besar hanya membayangkannya" is ambiguous. "ia" could mean the scientists. Make the subject clear, e.g. "bahwa Griffith sebagian besar mengkhayalkannya" or "bahwa tanaman itu sebagian besar hanya khayalannya".
Item 10: 'nightshade' is left in English. Give the Indonesian "terong-terongan" (Solanum) or put the English in brackets.
Item 2: "Pupuk: tidak perlu sampai sedikit" and "CO2: tidak perlu sampai sedikit" are awkward. Use "tidak perlu hingga sedikit" or "tidak diperlukan sampai dalam jumlah rendah".
Item 6: "menahun (perenial)" is redundant. "Bertalus" and "mengolonisasi" are stiff. Use "tanaman tahunan/abadi" and "menjajah/tumbuh di".

myriophyllum-elatinoides.name: Myriophyllum elatinoides
notes: Item 4: "cukup besar/signifikan" leaves a slash alternative in the text; choose one, e.g. "cukup besar".
Item 8 Conclusion: "menutupi/menguasai semua tanaman lain" has a slash alternative and adds "tanaman lain" (the English says "everything in the tank"); use "menguasai seisi akuarium".
Item 5 Quarantine: "nimfa capung, nimfa capung jarum" is fine, but "pot/gelas kultur" has a slash alternative; use one term, e.g. "wadah kultur".
Item 6: "teramati juga bahwa" is stiff; use "juga diamati bahwa" or "pertumbuhannya tercatat lebih lambat".
Item 7: "tidak tahan teduh" is awkward; use "tidak tahan ternaungi/kurang cahaya dalam jangka panjang". "kurus menjulang (leggy)" is also awkward; use "kurus dan menjulang" or "etiolasi".
Item 7: "sistem CO2 bertekanan (tabung)" adds "(tabung)", which is not in the source; remove it.
Item 1: "Water milfoil" was left as the common name with no Indonesian equivalent; this is acceptable, but consider "Myriophyllum/ganggang air" if a local name exists.

myriophyllum-mattogrossense.name: Myriophyllum mattogrossense
notes: "membuka membentuk kipas" is slightly awkward; "menyebar membentuk kipas" is more natural for "spread out in a fan shape".
"Pilihan yang bagus untuk pemula" is fine, but "A good starter plant" could be "tanaman pemula yang bagus" to keep "plant" explicit (very minor).

myriophyllum-sp-guyana.name: Myriophyllum sp. 'Guyana'
notes: Item 3: "Tanaman air" for "Aquarium plant" is acceptable but "tanaman akuarium" would be more precise.
Item 3: "cup tertutup" – consider "cup tertutup" in italics or "wadah tertutup (closed cup)"; minor.

najas-guadalupensis.name: Guppy Grass
notes: Item 2: the source text is in Vietnamese, not English; the Indonesian translation matches its content well, so no real problem, but the source mismatch should be flagged.
Item 1: 'aquarist' left in English; use 'penghobi akuarium' or 'aquascaper'.
Item 1: 'perbanyakannya gampang sekali' is a bit colloquial for a handbook; consider 'mudah diperbanyak'.

nymphaea-lotus.name: Nymphaea lotus
notes: Item 2: "Substrat dasar" is slightly redundant; "substrat" or "dasar akuarium yang kaya nutrisi" reads more naturally.
Item 2: "membentuk banyak daun di bawah air" could be "daun bawah air" or "daun terendam", the terms hobbyists usually use, but the meaning is intact.

nymphaea-stellata.name: Dwarf Lily
notes: "Lama-kelamaan tanaman ini menumbuhkan tangkai panjang": fine, but "daun berbentuk mata panah sepanjang sekitar 10 cm" is OK; "hijau kemerahmudaan" is awkward/non-standard, use "hijau kemerah jambuan" or "hijau merah muda".
"pupuk tablet akar (root tabs)": more natural as "pupuk tablet akar" or "tablet pupuk akar (root tabs)".
"sangat baik dalam menyerap senyawa limbah organik": slightly stiff; "sangat efektif menyerap" reads more naturally.
"Dwarf aquarium lily" is left in English throughout; consider adding a local name such as "teratai kerdil" at first mention.
"tanaman tengah (midground) atau latar belakang (background)": "tanaman tengah" is awkward; use "tanaman area tengah" or "tanaman bagian tengah".

nymphaea-zenkeri.name: Tiger Lotus
notes: "tetapi yang terpenting adalah umbinya sehat" is slightly awkward; better "yang terpenting adalah umbi yang sehat".
"akar akan menancapkan umbi dengan kokoh" is slightly unnatural; use "akar akan menahan umbi dengan kokoh".
"daun teratai yang mengambang": "lily pads" is rendered as "daun teratai", which is fine, but "Tiger lotus ... daun apung" is used for "lily pad" in pruning; keep the term consistent.

nymphoides-aquatica.name: Banana Plant
notes: "substrat setidaknya sekitar 5 cm": 'at least' plus 'sekitar' is contradictory; use "setidaknya 5 cm".

"Jangan sampai umbinya ... tertimbun dan tercekik": the source says only 'suffocate'; 'tertimbun' is an added nuance, and it contradicts the later advice to plant the tubers 0.6 cm into the substrate. Use "jangan sampai umbi tercekik/terkubur terlalu dalam".
"tanaman yang tidak butuh banyak cahaya" in item 1 is clumsy; use "tanaman cahaya rendah" or "tidak menuntut cahaya tinggi".
"Banana plant", "banana lily" and "aquatic banana plant" are left in English with no Indonesian hobby name or italics. Add a gloss or consistent usage, e.g. "tanaman pisang air".
"latar depan/latar tengah/latar belakang": hobbyists usually say "foreground/midground/background" or "bagian depan/tengah/belakang akuarium".
"root tab yang ditanam tepat di bawah tanaman": 'inserted' is better rendered as "dibenamkan/diselipkan"; "pupuk cair all-in-one yang bagus" could be "pupuk cair lengkap (all-in-one)".

nymphoides-hydrophylla.name: Nymphoides hydrophylla 'Taiwan'
notes: "daun yang mengapung di permukaan": the English says "surface leaves" (leaves that reach the surface); "mengapung" is a slight interpretation. Consider "daun yang sudah mencapai permukaan".
"helaian daun yang tua": "plates of old leaves" means leaf blades. This is fine, but "Tanaman baru tumbuh dari helaian daun tua" would read more naturally.
"hijau muda pekat dan transparan": "pekat" (dense) next to "hijau muda" (light green) is contradictory. Use "hijau muda cerah/intens" for "intense, light-green".
"banyaknya daun di bawah air": consider the hobby term "daun submerse" (daun terendam).

peperomia-emarginella.name: Peperomia emarginella
notes: "asal Amerika tropis" is slightly awkward; "dari wilayah tropis Amerika" is more natural.
"layout terrarium" could be "tata letak terarium"; "terrarium" is usually spelled "terarium" in standard Indonesian, though both are common.

peperomia-prostrata.name: Peperomia prostrata
notes: "berupa perpaduan garis-garis hijau muda": English says "markings" (bercak/corak), not "lines"; "garis-garis" adds a detail that is not in the source. Use "corak/bercak hijau muda".
"setup tropis": consider "aquascape/terarium tropis" or "set-up"; "setup" is acceptable but slightly informal.

philodendron-sp-mini-midget.name: Philodendron Mini Midget
notes: "ditanam dengan diikat pada kayu" is awkward; use "ditempelkan/diikat pada kayu" ("ditanam" and "diikat" are redundant together).
"greenhouse" left in English; prefer "rumah kaca".
"material hardscape" is acceptable but "bahan hardscape" is more natural; "hardscape" could also be glossed as "dekorasi/penataan keras".
"Hanya dalam kondisi yang sangat mendukung tingginya akan melebihi 20 cm" is slightly stiff; consider "Tinggi lebih dari 20 cm hanya tercapai pada kondisi yang sangat mendukung".

phyllanthus-fluitans.name: Phyllanthus fluitans
notes: "menolak air" is a literal rendering of "water-repellent"; more natural: "bersifat hidrofobik" or "anti air/tidak basah oleh air".
"differing only in the single-leaf structure on each node": "struktur satu daun di setiap ruas" is a bit awkward; better "hanya berbeda karena setiap ruas hanya memiliki satu daun".
"mengeluarkan bunga": "menghasilkan bunga" or "berbunga" is more natural.

plagiomnium-sp-thyme-moss.name: Thyme Moss
notes: "woodland-like atmosphere" rendered as "suasana seperti hutan" is fine; no major issues. Minor: "layout" could be "tata letak/aquascape" but acceptable.

pogostemon-deccanensis.name: Pogostemon deccanensis
notes: Item 3: "Cahaya kuat memberi semburat kuning di bagian pucuk" is fine, but "pupuk kolom air" is slightly awkward; consider "pemupukan lewat air (kolom air)" for naturalness.

pogostemon-helferi.name: Pogostemon helferi

Item 7: "akuarium yang sudah melewati siklus nitrogen dan benar-benar matang sangat penting" awkward; also "peka ... melting" mixed English — consider "meleleh/rontok (melting)".

Item 8: "daun yang sehat dan tebal" for "fleshy foliage" and "rakus nutrisi" for "heavy feeder" are acceptable but "lembek" for "flaccid" fine; "sistem CO2 bertekanan (tabung)" adds "(tabung)" not in source.
Item 10: "Burma" retained; fine. Item 11 references untranslated is fine.

pogostemon-quadrifolius.name: Pogostemon Octopus
notes: Item 11: 'pond snails' translated as 'siput' — this drops 'pond'; use 'siput kolam/siput hama'. Minor.
Item 11: 'long, wispy bright green foliage' → 'daun panjang, tipis' drops 'wispy' (halus/lembut); minor.
Item 11: 'burayak' is used for fry, but for 'frogs ... fish and fry' this is fine; however 'tadpoles' is not in source, so no change needed.

Item 2: 'Octopus plant' left untranslated as other name is fine.

pogostemon-stellatus.name: Pogostemon stellatus

Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The meaning is carried over faithfully, but check that the source was the right one.

proserpinaca-palustris.name: Proserpinaca palustris
notes: Item 6: "1-2 inches in a month" converted to "2,5–5 cm per bulan" is correct; but "dengan pencahayaan kurang" is fine. No issue here.

Item 10: "Air terlalu sadah dan/atau pH terlalu basa" fine; "Nutrient sensitive ... cannot survive without nutrition for a long time" is OK.
Item 1: "Bisa ditanam emersed" and "Midground dan background" leave English terms without Indonesian; consider "di atas permukaan air (emers)" and "tengah dan belakang".

Item 11: "Dengan kondisi cahaya yang baik, warnanya berubah menjadi tembaga yang cantik" okay; "cup" could be "cup (wadah)".

ranunculus-inundatus.name: Ranunculus inundatus

"cup tertutup": 'closed cup' left as English; consider 'cup tertutup (closed cup)' or 'wadah/cup tertutup'.

riccardia-chamedryfolia.name: Riccardia

riccia-fluitans.name: Riccia

rotala-indica-bonsai.name: Rotala indica 'Bonsai'

"rumpunnya atau karpetnya jadi lebih rapat" is slightly awkward. Prefer "agar rumpun atau karpetnya lebih rapat".

rotala-rotundifolia.name: Rotala rotundifolia
notes: Item 8, Quarantine: 'dan lain-lain' after the nymphs is fine, but 'Karantina' lacks the advice sense; fine. Real issue: 'Teman setangki' is non-standard; use 'Tank mate' as 'penghuni akuarium lain' or 'teman sekolam'.

Item 1: 'Perbanyakan: stek pucuk atau runner (sulur)' — 'runner' is left as English; use 'sulur (runner)'. 'Tanaman batang (stem)' ok.

rotala-rotundifolia-h-ra.name: Rotala H'ra
notes: "cup tertutup": 'cup' left in English; could use "pot/cup kultur jaringan tertutup" — minor.

rotala-wallichii.name: Rotala wallichii
notes: "gampang dipangkas" (also in 3): informal register for a handbook; consider "mudah dipangkas".

sagittaria-subulata.name: Sagittaria subulata

salvinia-auriculata.name: Kiambang

salvinia-minima.name: Salvinia minima

selaginella-uncinata.name: Selaginella uncinata
notes: "paku rane" is a questionable rendering of "moss fern"; better use "paku-pakuan lumut" or "selaginella (paku lumut)" for clarity.

shinnersia-rivularis.name: Shinnersia

"liverwort" is left in English; consider adding the Indonesian "lumut hati" in brackets for readers who don't know the term. This is minor.
"rata-rata tinggi setelah dua bulan" reads slightly awkwardly; "tinggi rata-rata setelah dua bulan" is more natural.

spirodela-polyrrhiza.name: Giant Duckweed
notes: "aquarist" is left in English; use "aquascaper" or "penghobi akuarium" instead.
"Daunnya" for "fronds": duckweed has thalli, not true leaves. This is acceptable, but "talus" or "daun" is fine and not a real error.
"Kebutuhan cahaya": "Tuntutan cahaya" is not needed. The current wording is fine.

staurogyne-repens.name: Staurogyne repens
notes: Item 9: "White Mountain minnow (white cloud)" adds an alias that is not in the source. Keep only the name, or use the common local name.
Item 9: "Karena lembut dan disukai pemakan tanaman" is a loose rendering of "delicate and palatable". Something like "Karena daunnya lembut dan enak dimakan" is clearer.

taxiphyllum-alternans.name: Taiwan Moss
notes: Item 4: "Be sure to have the habitat ready before purchase" is translated as "Pastikan tempatnya sudah siap". "Tempatnya" is vague. Use "habitatnya" or "akuarium/penataannya".
Item 5: "family Isopterygium" is kept as written, but Isopterygium is a genus, not a family. The source error is carried over. Consider "genus" if the translator may correct it, or flag it.
Item 3: "diikat ke kayu" is fine, but "Attaching" could be "ditempelkan/diikat". "menyamarkan peralatan" for "hiding installations" is slightly narrow. "instalasi/perlengkapan" would be closer.

taxiphyllum-barbieri.name: Java Moss
notes: #5: "burayak" is a regional term for fry; "benih ikan" or "anakan ikan" is more common for hobbyists, and "burayak" also sounds inconsistent next to "anakan ikan" in the same passage.
#6: "mirip tanaman rambat" for ivy is loose; "mirip ivy/sirih belanda" would be more precise.
#3: "Udang dengan senang hati akan memakan habis serabut putih" is slightly stiff; the "white fluff" is also vague, so say that the shrimp eat the algae.
#6: "melayang di situ" for "float there" is awkward; "mengambang" would be more natural.

taxiphyllum-sp-flame-moss.name: Flame Moss
notes: "cup tertutup": 'cup' left in English; prefer "cup tertutup" is acceptable but more natural is "dalam wadah/cup tertutup (closed cup)" - minor.
"Ikatkan moss ini pada batu-batu kecil atau dalam ikatan-ikatan kecil": slightly awkward; use "atau dalam ikatan kecil pada akar kayu" and avoid reduplicated plurals.
"permukaan yang datar": English says 'horizontal surfaces'; fine, but 'menyebar ke samping' is okay; consider "permukaan horizontal" for fidelity.
Height in list (3–10+ cm) vs text (5–15 cm) is a source inconsistency, correctly preserved; no change needed.

taxiphyllum-sp-spiky-moss.name: Spiky Moss
notes: Item 2: "Paling pas disebut sebagai kakaknya Christmas moss" is colloquial; better "Bisa digambarkan sebagai versi lebih besar dari Christmas moss".
Item 2: "tetap subur di bawah cahaya yang sangat redup" is a bit loose for "thrives at a very low light intensity"; "tumbuh baik pada intensitas cahaya sangat rendah" is more faithful.
Item 2: "dengan jarak sedikit di antaranya" is awkward; use "dengan jarak tanam yang rapat/kecil antarrumpun".

utricularia-graminifolia.name: Utricularia graminifolia
notes: Item 1: "Asal" is slightly terse; "Asal daerah" or "Asal usul" would be more natural. Minor only.
Item 3: "halaman rumput" for "lawn" is acceptable. "hamparan rumput" would be a bit more natural. Minor only.
Item 3: "cukup rewel" for "rather demanding" is informal. "cukup menuntut" or "cukup sulit dirawat" would be more neutral. Minor only.

vallisneria.name: Vallisneria
notes: "Beri nutrisi" is slightly vague for "Feed it"; "beri pupuk" would be clearer for plants.
"karena perawatannya jauh lebih ringan" adds an explanation. The source only says it is a reprieve from maintenance, so keep it closer, e.g. "jeda dari perawatan".

vallisneria-americana-natans.name: Vallisneria Natans
notes: "geragih" for stolon/runner is a non-standard term; hobbyists usually say "stolon" or "sulur" – use consistent term (item 1 gives "stolon (geragih)", item 3 uses "geragih (runner)"; unify, e.g. "stolon/sulur").
"disatukan dengan pemberat": "anchor" here is the lead/rubber plant weight; "pemberat" is OK but consider "pemberat timah" for clarity.
"tanaman air yang tangguh": "hardy" is more naturally "tahan banting/mudah dirawat".

vallisneria-sp-gigantea.name: Vallisneria Gigantea
notes: Item 3: "runner (tunas merambat)" is fine, but "Vallisneria americana" differs from the source's species only if the source was changed; no fix needed beyond consistency.
Item 2: "menghalangi cahaya" is slightly looser than "taking too much light"; consider "merebut/menyerap terlalu banyak cahaya dari tanaman di bawahnya".

vallisneria-spiralis.name: Vallisneria Spiralis Tiger
notes: Item 1: the height says '20–30+ cm', but item 3 gives the leaves as 30–50 cm. This mismatch is in the source, so the translation is faithful and needs no change.
Item 2: 'runner' is left in English. Consider 'sulur' or 'stolon', or 'runner' in italics or brackets after the local term. This is minor.

vesicularia-ferriei.name: Weeping Moss
notes: Item 3: English says 1-3 cm tall, while item 1 says 3-5+ cm; that is a source inconsistency, so keep it as is.
Item 3: "tebal berdaging" is redundant and awkward for "fleshy"; use "berdaging" or "tebal".
Item 2: "Weeping tidak banyak menuntut" is slightly vague for "has low demands"; "perawatannya mudah" or "tidak menuntut perawatan khusus" is more natural.
Item 1: "Moss" for Type is fine, but "Asal" would read more naturally as "Asal daerah" or "Asal: Asia".

vesicularia-montagnei.name: Christmas Moss
notes: "lebih rewel" is slightly colloquial for "more demanding"; consider "lebih menuntut perawatan" or "lebih sulit dirawat".
